intro: Add your own fields to every task in this workspace: budget, story points, risk, customer… Anyone who can edit a task fills them in.
onCardTip: Show this field as a chip on the task on the board
removeBody: The field disappears from every task, and the values people entered are deleted. This cannot be undone.
